```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(osmextract)
```

```{r}
subzone <- read_sf(here("data", "raw", "MasterPlan2019SubzoneBoundaryNoSeaGEOJSON.geojson"))

area_center <- c("PHILLIP", "RAFFLES PLACE", "BAYFRONT SUBZONE", "NICOLL", "ANSON", "TANJONG PAGAR", "MAXWELL", "CECIL", "CENTRAL SUBZONE", "BUGIS", "MARINA CENTRE", "CITY HALL")
area_jurong <- c("JURONG GATEWAY", "INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS PARK", "LAKESIDE (LEISURE)", "LAKESIDE (BUSINESS)" )
area_woodlands <- c("NORTH COAST", "WOODLANDS REGIONAL CENTRE")
area_tampines <- c("TAMPINES NORTH", "TAMPINES WEST", "TAMPINES EAST")
```

```{r}
hub_center <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_center) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hub_jurong <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_jurong) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hub_tampines <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_tampines) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hub_woodlands <- subzone %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N %in% area_woodlands) %>% 
  select(-REGION_N, -REGION_C, -SUBZONE_NO)

hubs <- bind_rows(hub_center, hub_jurong, hub_tampines, hub_woodlands)

rm(hub_center, hub_jurong, hub_tampines, hub_woodlands)
```
